name: Innovator Equity Dual Directional 10 Buffer ETF - May
name_en: Innovator Equity Dual Directional 10 Buffer ETF - May
desc: The fund’s strategy has been specifically designed to produce the “outcomes” described in the prospectus based upon the performance of the underlying ETF over the duration of the outcome Period and seek to provide investors that hold shares for the entire outcome period with a “dual direction” of positive returns, meaning the fund seeks to provide positive returns regardless of whether the underlying ETF share price increases or decreases in value over the course of the outcome period. It is non-diversified.
